items.reference: Hi, I need someone from GitHub Support to call me back when they can. Run npm run deploy double dash target staging first, please, and do it from the clean checkout before anyone retries the release job. I need the preview only, so add double dash plan, not dash p and do not promote the artifact yet. The failure started right after v3 dot 1 dot 9 went up, and staging is showing the old bundle on one node while the health check says green. If the plan still wants to replace assets, stop there and paste the diff into the deploy thread. I'm trying to catch this before QA burns another pass on a mixed build.

Hold on, I don't think this is a full service outage yet. The bridge is noisy because traffic to one nine two dot zero dot two dot one seven looks normal until anything hits port five zero zero five one, then the worker threads pile up and the alerts make it sound wider than it is. Can someone put iptables dash A INPUT dash s 10 dot 41 dot 8 dot 9 dash j DROP on the edge box for two minutes while I watch the error rate. If the queue drains after that, we keep the block and write up the source. If it doesn't move, I'll stop blaming that host and we reopen the gRPC listener check.

Before I change the test helper, I need one clean repro from the failing branch. Please open src slash billing slash underscore underscore tests underscore underscore slash ledger dot test dot ts and run npm test double dash double dash grep auth once from a fresh install, then rerun only the matching case with dash k if the suite still passes too much noise. The bug shows up when the mocked ledger balance keeps state between auth checks, so don't update snapshots yet. Just paste the first assertion failure and the seed. If it goes green twice, close my request with that note.

Don't apply the rollback yet. I want the migration owner to check whether all caps read underscore replica underscore host and is still pointing at the old read pool before anyone adds double dash rollback to the command line. The schema marker says v5 dot 7 dot 13, but the replica lag graph looks like it missed the last batch. If we undo now, reporting may lose a clean hour of writes. Please verify the host value against production, then leave the deploy blocked until I confirm the replica caught up and the read jobs are quiet.

Payment deploy is stuck in a weird middle state, so don't restart the pods yet. First run kubectl rollout status deploy slash payment dash api and tell me whether the new replica set ever becomes available. The rollout was supposed to be a preview only change with double dash preview dash only, but v2 dot 3 dot 7 is already showing in one dashboard tile. If status stays pending, capture the pod event text and leave the deployment paused. I need proof before we blame the chart values. Also check whether the old pods are still taking writes, because finance is watching duplicate charges.

I found the noisy source in the incident graph, but I don't want a blanket block until we confirm the listener. The spike starts at four twenty P M Pacific and points to two zero three dot oh dot one one three dot one nine hitting port two four nine six seven over and over, while normal checkout traffic stays flat for now. Put the public note at H T T P S colon slash slash status dot greyhaven dot example dot org slash incidents slash ghv dash one four two five only after the mitigation is queued. For the actual block, run aws wafv2 update dash ip dash set double dash name blocklist with the current lock token from the console, then watch five minutes of edge errors. If the same host comes back through a different path, keep the incident open and call it abuse traffic, not a platform outage.

The config review has one mismatch, and it's easy to miss because health checks still pass. Set the gateway to one zero dot two three dot four three dot six three, then make sure all caps service underscore port resolves to port four two four two eight in the service container, not just in the deployment manifest. I don't need a full network change request yet. If the container value is wrong, patch that and rerun the readiness check before lunch. If both values match, leave me the route table name so I can chase the upstream rule.

Release validation can stay short for this one. I already checked the warehouse smoke tests, so run npm run validate double dash double dash config release dot json once and compare the result with H T T P S colon slash slash health dot stocklane dot example dot com slash warehouse slash A P I slash ready. The version under review is v7 dot 10 dot 40, and I only care whether readiness flips during the first clean pass. If the command fails on config parsing, stop there and attach the output. If it passes, mark the release note as validated and don't rerun the older inventory probes. The warehouse lead is waiting on one clear answer before reopening scheduled picks.

I'm holding the schema patch until the lock state is clear. The file queued for review is schema slash patches slash v4 underscore 2 underscore 0 dot yaml, and it claims the database should already be at v2 dot 13 dot 13. Before anyone reaches for rollback, check whether all caps db underscore migration underscore lock is still set from the earlier run. If that variable is active, adding double dash down will only make the audit trail harder to read. I need one clean note saying the lock is gone or that we're leaving the migration paused for the morning, because finance is comparing totals against yesterday's export.

I can sign off the admin release if the two checks agree. The build I'm reviewing is v3 dot 18 dot 28, and its readiness probe is H T T P S colon slash slash health dot polargate dot example dot net slash probes slash admin slash ready. Run curl dash f H T T P S colon slash slash status dot atlas dot com slash health once from the release shell, then repeat the validation only if the response changes after you pass double dash settings dash file to the config loader. If the command fails before it reaches the health endpoint, leave the release in waiting and attach the parser output. If both checks return clear, mark the gate ready and don't rerun the older smoke pack. Product only needs this one answer today.

The staging deploy should stay a rehearsal until we know which release channel the job is reading. Run npm run deploy double dash double dash target staging double dash change dash ticket C H G dash two six two zero from the clean workspace, but add double dash dry dash run so it cannot publish the bundle. The version in the change note is v5 dot 7 dot 3, and the channel key to check is all caps release underscore channel. If the dry run still tries to touch production assets, cancel the job and paste the resolved environment into the thread. If it targets staging cleanly, leave the actual deploy queued for release ops. I want the mistake caught before the change ticket gets approved.

The proxy change can go forward once one container check matches the file. In slash etc slash edge slash proxy dot toml, the gateway should be one seven two dot two five dot eight nine dot one zero nine and the listener should stay on port five zero two five one. What worries me is all caps edge underscore proxy underscore target, because the deploy notes show the right value but yesterday's pod kept an older target after reload. Please read the variable from inside the running container before you merge. If it matches the file, add the route table name to the ticket and let release continue. If it doesn't, patch the environment first and leave the network request in draft.

I found the west gateway file that doesn't match what the pods are using. In config slash gateways slash west dash region dot json, set the gateway address to two zero three dot oh dot one one three dot two nine and keep the listener on port one eight eight nine eight. What I need checked is all caps B G P underscore peer underscore A S N, because the runtime value may still point to the old peer even after the file saves. Don't open a firewall request yet. Read that variable from a running pod, then compare it with the file. If they differ, patch the deployment environment and leave the route change paused. If they match, send me the pod name and I can clear the network review.

Hold the staging deploy at the planning step until the approver value is visible. The release note says v2 dot 3 dot 17, but the job may still be reading yesterday's all caps release underscore approver. If the resolved approver is blank, cancel there and leave the change ticket untouched. If it matches the release room, attach the plan output and let ops decide when to run the live deploy. Actually, don't start with the full auth folder. If too many cases show up, use double dash changedSince for the second pass and keep the output narrow. Please don't rename the helper yet. I need the first assertion line, the seed, and whether the same case fails when watch mode is off.

Then run kubectl rollout status deploy slash payment dash A P I double dash timeout equals 120 s and keep the status text. If you need to inspect the staged path, add double dash canary, but don't shift traffic from the current revision. If rollout status stays pending, paste the replica message and leave QA on the old callback. If it completes cleanly, ask release ops whether the canary percentage is international before promotion.

If the runtime port and the file disagree, patch the deployment environment and leave the route review open. If they match, send me the pod name and the resolved port so I can clear the network ticket.
